bands.headline: The year keeps its shape
bands.body: Parish bells ring as they did last year. Stewards argue over tithes. The war with England is the trouble men name.

bands.headline: A hard season, variously explained
bands.body: Chroniclers note empty houses in the ports. Physicians speak of bad air. Preachers speak of sin. No one account has won the chancery.

bands.headline: The mortality is no longer a rumor
bands.body: The burying grounds overflow. Trade falters. Learned men still dispute whether this is a punishment, a poison, or a fever that will pass.

bands.headline: The ordinary explanations fail
bands.body: Witnesses describe what the old books did not budget for. Clergy and captains argue over which office should answer first.
